items.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000
items.q: No, the only bebop we had records of was Billy Eckstine when he was doing the big band stuff.

ctx.x: Were you that familiar with bebop up to that point?
No, the only bebop we had records of was Billy Eckstine when he was doing the big band stuff.
Well you had a number of phases with Dizzy in the small group and the big band?
